name: Neuro-diversified Benchmark Generator
description: A generator that produces neuro-diversified synthetic benchmark problems for evaluating the performance and robustness of black-box optimization algorithms.
reputation: Moderately cited academic benchmark generator used in black‑box optimization research.
notes: Non‑LLM benchmark producing synthetic test functions; may not fully reflect real‑world problem structure, risk of overfitting algorithms to the generator, and performance depends strongly on problem scaling and evaluation budget.
